fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance at the SW corner: a guard-booth structure sits on a raised island in the truck driveway, with the lane splitting in/out around it - a clear checkpoint pinch-point. Internal pavement markings read 'ALL TRUCKS' directing truck flow. Confirmed in z20-z21 satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small dark-roofed booth structure on a raised island in the truck lane at the SW entrance, with a vehicle parked beside it - classic guard shack footprint. Visible in z19-z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed guard shack is present.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on both long building faces (NW and SE), consistent with separate shipping and receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal truck circulation with a teardrop-shaped 'ALL TRUCKS' staging loop on the NW side; ample room for 3+ trucks to queue between gate and docks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large trailer-storage areas on both the NW and NE sides packed with parked trailers; legacy DSC Logistics DC operating heavy trailer-pool activity.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock banks on both long faces with many trailers backed in; ~120 doors estimated - low confidence on exact count from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the NW side of the industrial park but appears to serve the adjacent buildings/Nestle plant, not the CJ building; no spur enters the CJ DC. Marked false, low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is in the Breinigsville/Lehigh Valley industrial corridor - a large warehouse cluster on the edge of farmland and woods, not within dense metro fabric; judged Rural per the broader edge-of-town setting.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box (~455m x ~380m) covering the CJ building and its trailer yards.
fieldNotes.facilityNote: 400 Nestle Way is a legacy DSC Logistics distribution center; DSC was acquired by and is now operated as CJ Logistics America. The white-roof building is the CJ DC; the adjacent red/dark building to the NE is the Nestle plant (separate facility).
